intervals.label: proposal submitted to the J-PARC PAC; Stage-1 status recommended
intervals.locator: KOTO II group page, news list
intervals.note: The J-PARC PAC recommended Stage-1 status with the experiment number J-PARC E107 on 11 April 2025 ("Apr 11, 2025 Stage-1 Status was recommended with the experiment number J-PARC E107"). Stage 1 is a scientific recommendation; no Stage-2 approval, funding or construction was found, so the status is `proposed`.
intervals.quote: Dec 9, 2024 KOTO II proposal (link) was submitted to J-PARC PAC

placements.note: Planned placement: the proposal puts the KOTO II beamline and experimental area in the Hadron Experimental Facility; campus-grade existing hall site.
placements.quote: a new experimental area behind the primary beam dump

summary.plain: A proposed detector made of a large crystal calorimeter and veto counters in a 12-metre decay region, looking for two photons from a neutral pion and nothing else.
summary.technical: Proposed detector with a 12 m signal decay region and a 3 m diameter calorimeter in a neutral beam extracted at 5 degrees, optimized for K_L -> pi0 nu nubar.
